response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced senior/staff-level engineer with nearly 20 years in the industry, which makes him significantly overqualified for an entry-level junior position. His core expertise lies in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang rather than Java, which appears only peripherally in his skill list. Critically, the role requires strong verbal and written German, while his German is listed as basic. Salary expectations, retention risk, and role misalignment make this a poor fit despite his obvious technical competence.
strengths: Strong software fundamentals: OOP, TDD, CI/CD, agile practices, and cloud/Kubernetes experience
Completed computer science degree and proven ability to deliver across web, mobile, and backend systems
Demonstrated collaboration, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing through workshops and talks
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level role — high flight and retention risk
German language skills are only basic, but strong German is a hard requirement
Java is not a primary skill — main experience is in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang
